items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: "I want you to come up and play with me, and play this job with me." ... "it will be just you and I playing" -- he played the drums and I play the piano.

ctx.x: musician. I'm learning, and I don't think there was a day since that piano was sitting in my home that I didn't play it, every chance I got, that one or any other piano.

So I guess it was just before my sixteenth birthday... I was standing in front of my house one day, with some of the other guys who I was playing around with. And this fellow came up and asked the crowd did they know this kid named John Malachi. They said, "Yeah, there he is right there." He said, "Are you John?" I said, "Yeah." He said, "You play the piano, right?" I said, "Yeah, I like the piano." So he says, "My name is Leo Aloysious Gilpoopy" -- which I thought was kind of funny, because I didn't know whether…
